## Objective
- Build a complete, playable Russian-language “Игра про камень” in the existing repository.

## Requirements
- Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions.
- Save small JPEG screenshots for checks (viewport ≤1280px wide) and inspect only the latest screenshot.

## Decisions
- Built a dark, atmospheric mining incremental game: hit rocks for shards, discover eight rock types, upgrade tools, and save progress in local storage.
